doc.title: Zeke Mullins interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 9, 2017

chapter: Early gigs and the war years
title: Learning organ and the Hammond B3 his wife bought
summary: Clubs with organs gave him work after a disastrous first try; later his wife bought him a Hammond B3 and Leslie.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: I wonder if that ended up actually giving you more opportunities to play?
It did. Because I ran into some clubs that had organs. And I’d never played an organ. And boy the first time I had occasion to run into one boy it was a disaster man.

Oh brother. But I’ll tell you, once I got the hang of it, you know, what is supposed to happen, I didn’t do too bad, I didn’t do too bad. In fact as the years went on and whatchacallit, I got married, the lady that I married bought me an organ. Bought me a Hammond B3 and a Leslie speaker. Went down to the store and paid cash. When she told the guy she was going to pay cash, his mouth opened.
And then you’ve got to move the darn thing, right?
